import time
from threading import Lock
from collections import OrderedDict

class ResponseCache:
    """In-process TTL cache with LRU eviction for GET /orders/{id} and GET /catalog/* responses."""

    def __init__(self, ttl_seconds: int = 300, max_items: int = 10000):
        self._ttl = ttl_seconds
        self._max_items = max_items
        self._store: OrderedDict[str, tuple[float, bytes]] = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = Lock()

    def get(self, key: str) -> bytes | None:
        with self._lock:
            item = self._store.get(key)
            if item is None:
                return None
            ts, value = item
            if time.monotonic() - ts > self._ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                return None
            # Move to end to mark as recently used
            self._store.move_to_end(key, last=True)
            return value

    def set(self, key: str, value: bytes) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                # Update existing entry and move to end
                self._store.move_to_end(key, last=True)
            elif len(self._store) >= self._max_items:
                # Remove least recently used item
                self._store.popitem(last=False)
            
            self._store[key] = (time.monotonic(), value)

    def clear_expired(self) -> int:
        """Manually clear all expired entries. Call periodically via background task."""
        with self._lock:
            now = time.monotonic()
            expired = [
                k for k, (ts, _) in self._store.items()
                if now - ts > self._ttl
            ]
            for k in expired:
                del self._store[k]
            return len(expired)
